page.title: Fernwood & Thistle Goods
page.text:
Fernwood & Thistle Goods
Useful things for home and trail, made in small batches.
Waxed Canvas Tote
Heavy olive canvas with leather handles. Carries a week of groceries.
Waxed Canvas Tote: $48
Enamel Camp Mug
Speckled enamel over steel, 12 oz. Fine on a camp stove.
Enamel Camp Mug: $14
Beeswax Pillar Candle
Hand poured, burns for about 40 hours.
Beeswax Pillar Candle: $18
Linen Tea Towels
Set of two, stonewashed, in sage.
Linen Tea Towels, set of 2: $22
Wool Camp Blanket
Undyed wool with a rust stripe. Pick a size.
Wool Camp Blanket, Small: $85
Wool Camp Blanket, Medium: $120
Wool Camp Blanket, Large: $160
Brass Key Hook
Solid brass, comes with two screws.
Brass Key Hook: $12
Shipping is a flat $6 per order, anywhere in the US.
To order, email us what you'd like and we'll send an invoice. This is a fictional store made for a demo.
